PREPARE_DESC: Copy your music folders into the input folder /mnt/HDD/in/music. Every nested folder is processed on its own, the structure does not matter (artist, album, compilation — anything). The input folder is cleaned after processing.
RESULT_DESC: Finished tracks are sorted by tags into /mnt/HDD/out/music: artist / album.
RUN_DESC: Press the button to open the preparation window: start button, current step and live log.
TOAST_EMPTY: No audio files in the input folder
TOAST_ERROR: Processing failed. See the plugin log.
TOAST_NO_DISK: /mnt/HDD is not available. Connect and mount the disk first.
TOAST_CANCELLED: Stopped. Finished albums are already in the output folder.
